2026-09-10T20:27:09.3465900Z Restarting after unexpected exit, crash, or test timeout; summary will include totals from previous launches.

scope: Both actual production cases ran once, passed concealed native entry, native selection, Hide and real authority-accepted native Play, then failed during Standard return. The 2D read failed its health condition through port quarantine; the 3D return wait failed with an otherwise dormant retained owner but stale authorityForegroundGrant. Both completed five Standard hand checkpoints, which do not invoke the ordinary audit callback. Original summaries, ActionTestSummary objects, compiler flags, exported observations and test log agree. Runner restart messages are retained without attributing a crash cause. Capture attachments reuse lastDocument and do not independently prove close duration or the exact native/Swift interleaving.
